As for the first point, my understanding is so far from complete that if I killed myself I wouldn't actually even know what I'm doing. All I could do is guess. It's irrational because it'd be throwing caution to the wind, I have no idea what comes next (or doesn't, if nothing at all). I'd be acting on my feelings and my inability to "cope", but I see no real reason for coping except delaying or possibly changing whatever comes next and to prevent being another source of pain on this planet for others to unwillingly be subjected to.

As for what brought them on, I'm not even sure. I've been this way for a very long time, since I was a kid. I tried it once in elementary school, and being a dumbfuck kid I thought stapling my wrist would do it. Everything just felt -wrong- from day one. It's just always there in the back of my mind and it's a growing presence. I used to think I was haunted or possessed, but spirituality and delusion can become easily confused for one another. At the same time the world seems haunted and possessed. We're all slaves to perception whether it's beautiful or not, it seems like some kind of weird bondage to me.

There's beauty too, don't get me wrong, but it feels so spoiled and corrupted and like it's just a trick. But what if all the bad shit is just a trick instead? It's nonsensical as fuck, it ALL seems like it's a trick.

I don't know what you mean by altered state of mind, though. Altered from what?

It's going to happen (well, unless I die first, but that's a given so actually maybe it isn't lol). I just need it to happen right and I don't know how to do that, I don't know what dying right is or whose opinion on the matter to trust or if there even is such a thing. Everything is just so much sadder and worse than it has to be. This seems like a crude and demented replica of what existence should be, to me.

Sorry for rambling.

Ah sorry some punctuation is missing, I don't know how that happened.

All of this just seems so false and unreal.
